items.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Restrict the all-socket sandbox escape hatch**

On Linux workstations where Docker’s Unix socket is visible and user-accessible (for example, a docker-group or rootless-Docker setup), an auto-approved sandboxed Bash command can use it to start a container with the host filesystem mounted, escaping the filesystem boundary; every other visible local daemon or agent socket is exposed as well. The stated need is limited to Herdr and the keyring, so keep the sandboxed default and require explicit unsandboxed approval or a narrowly scoped broker for those operations instead of granting every socket.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L79-L79](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/c2c1f6208923d9fa33c67ed6c2685e586b6d3c3b/AGENTS.md#L79-L79)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
items.disposition: pending-revise:T44-r2 (confirmed on the host: docker-group user + reachable systemd --user bus; allowAllUnixSockets is removed in r2)

items.author: github-actions
items.body:
The following taps are not trusted:
  aws/tap
  azure/bicep
  hashicorp/tap

Homebrew is currently ignoring formulae, casks and commands from these taps because tap trust is required.

Prefer trusting only the specific formulae, casks or commands you need.
Trust installed formulae from these taps with:
  brew trust --formula azure/bicep/bicep
  brew trust --formula hashicorp/tap/packer
Trust other specific casks and commands with:
  brew trust --cask <user>/<tap>/<cask>
  brew trust --command <user>/<tap>/<command>
Whole-tap trust is broader and includes all current and future formulae,
casks and commands from the listed taps. Trust whole taps with:
  brew trust aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
Untap them with:
  brew untap aws/tap azure/bicep hashicorp/tap
To disable trust checks:
  export HOMEBREW_NO_REQUIRE_TAP_TRUST=1
This is not recommended and will be removed in a later release.
For more information, see:
  https://docs.brew.sh/Tap-Trust
